description: Unit test class 'BasketWithItems' that tests the 'BasketWithItemsSpecification' functionality in the eShopWeb application's specifications. It contains test methods verifying filtering baskets by basket ID and buyer ID with mock Basket objects.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: Unit test class for BasketWithItemsSpecification in the eShopWeb project. Implements tests for basket filtering by ID and buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with the specified basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that no baskets are matched if the basket ID is not present in the collection.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that no baskets are matched if the buyer ID is not present in the collection.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates a list of mock Basket objects with predetermined IDs and BuyerId for testing.
